title: simplify to single-user shared mailbox
description:
## Why

The current multi-user model adds per-user routing, per-session user_id resolution, cross-user access guards, and per-user Sieve evaluation. stoa is a single-operator system: one INBOX, one set of special folders, one Sieve filter. Every MUA that can authenticate sees the same data. Remove all user_id partitioning from the mail store.

## What changes

### SMTP delivery
- Remove the `config.users` loop that matches RCPT TO against per-user email addresses. Accept all local RCPT TO for delivery regardless of envelope address.
- Evaluate Sieve **once per message** using a single global script (keyed to a fixed slug in the existing script store, e.g. `_global`). No per-recipient evaluation.
- Reject-before-deliver semantics preserved: Reject action still aborts the transaction.
- `UserConfig { email }` removed from smtp config; the users array is no longer used for delivery routing.

### Mail schema
- Drop `user_id` column from `mailbox_messages` (new migration, recreate table).
- Drop `user_id` column from `user_mailboxes` (new migration, recreate table).
- Provision the single set of six special folders once at server startup, not on every JMAP request.

### JMAP server
- Remove `resolve_user_id` call from `route_method`. No per-session user_id.
- Remove per-request `provision_user_mailboxes` call.
- Drop `AND user_id = ?` guard from all SQL queries in Email/get, Email/query, sieve_delivery.
- All authenticated sessions share the same mailbox contents; auth still required to connect.

### Sieve admin API
- `PUT /scripts/_global/active` installs the single global filter.
- Per-user endpoints (`/scripts/{username}/active`) can remain for now but are not evaluated.

## What stays the same
- SMTP AUTH (users table, password hashing) — still required to submit outbound mail
- JMAP authentication — still required; just no data isolation between sessions
- Special folder set (INBOX, Sent, Drafts, Trash, Junk, Archive)
- Sieve action semantics: Keep→INBOX, FileInto(newsgroup:…)→NNTP, FileInto(folder)→named mailbox, Discard, Reject
- All existing JMAP method handlers (Email/get, Email/query, Mailbox/get, etc.)

## Acceptance criteria
- A message delivered to any RCPT TO address appears in INBOX for all authenticated JMAP sessions.
- Sieve evaluation runs once per inbound message, not once per recipient.
- No `user_id` column in `mailbox_messages` or `user_mailboxes`.
- cargo fmt + clippy -D warnings + cargo test --workspace all pass clean.
notes: Review converged after 2 round(s). Round 1: stoa-17ee367f (5 P0 filed, 4 false-alarmed, 1 real fixed). Round 2: stoa-8eec3f9d (1 P1 metric edge-case fixed). SEC7 stated: past point of bikeshedding, 92% confidence.
